criterion.given: I navigate to the Data Entry page
criterion.then: I see a form with fields: Facility name (required), Facility type (required, dropdown: FNB Flexi Option, Standard Bank Access Bond), Credit limit (required, ZAR currency input, minimum R0), Current balance/utilization (required, ZAR currency input, can be negative), Interest rate (required, percentage input 0-100%)

criterion.given: I fill out the form with valid data
criterion.then: the facility is saved to Dexie database with createdAt and updatedAt timestamps
I see a success toast "Flexi facility saved"

criterion.given: I already have ONE flexi facility
criterion.then: the "Add Flexi Facility" button is disabled and shows "Edit" instead

criterion.when: I view the flexi facility section
criterion.then: I see a card displaying: name, type, credit limit (ZAR formatted), current balance (ZAR formatted), available credit (calculated: limit - balance), interest rate
the form is populated with existing data

criterion.given: I modify fields in edit mode and click "Save"
criterion.then: the facility is updated in database and I see success toast "Flexi facility updated"

criterion.when: I see the confirmation dialog and confirm
criterion.then: the facility is removed from database and I see success toast "Flexi facility deleted"

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Support for SA-specific flexi facilities (FNB Flexi Option, Standard Bank Access Bond). Single facility limit per user. Used for velocity banking and flexi chunking strategies.

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: All data persisted to IndexedDB via Dexie with useLiveQuery for reactive queries. FlexiFacility table defined with auto-increment id, indexed by name and createdAt.

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: All monetary calculations use big.js for decimal precision. Avoid floating point errors in financial calculations.

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Forms use React Hook Form with Zod validation. Uncontrolled inputs for performance. Schema-based validation with type inference.

doc.title: Epic 2 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: AC 2.2.1-2.2.5 define flexi facility CRUD with single facility constraint. Only ONE flexi facility allowed per user. Form disabled if one exists.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Card-based layouts, shadcn/ui components (Card, Form, Input, Button, Select, AlertDialog), teal color scheme for actions, ZAR currency formatting.

node.purpose: Precision decimal arithmetic for available credit calculation

constraints.constraint: Only ONE flexi facility allowed per user. saveFacility must check existing count before insert and return error if facility exists.
All data persisted via Dexie/IndexedDB. No server transmission (NFR-S1).
All monetary calculations use big.js for precision. availableCredit = creditLimit - currentBalance.
Zod schemas validate all fields before database operations. Input validation per NFR-S3.
Store interest rate as decimal (0.115), input/display as percentage (11.5%). Use conversion helpers.
currentBalance can be negative (representing available credit/overpaid).
All async operations return Result type. Use ok() for success, err() for failures.
Success operations show toast.success(), failures show toast.error().
All new files must be added to barrel exports (index.ts files).

interface.signature: z.object({ name: z.string().min(1).max(100), type: z.enum(['fnb_flexi', 'standard_bank_access']), creditLimit: z.string().refine(val => parseFloat(val) >= 0), currentBalance: z.string().refine(val => !isNaN(parseFloat(val))), // can be negative interestRate: z.string().refine(val => parseFloat(val) >= 0 && parseFloat(val) <= 100), })

tests.standards: Vitest test framework with React Testing Library for component tests. Tests co-located in tests/ directory mirroring src/ structure. Use fake-indexeddb/auto for Dexie tests. Follow existing patterns from tests/hooks/useAccounts.test.ts and tests/components/accounts/*.test.tsx. All async operations should be wrapped in act() and use waitFor() for state updates. Current test count: 206 tests passing.
